title: AI Is Wiping Out All These Jobs
description:
Real people are out of work and have been searching for months. Some of them say AI took their work. This is not a warning about the future. It's already happening in jobs that felt safe just two years ago... and the next jobs in line are the ones you were told a machine could never do.

I go through the numbers, job by job. Employers named AI as a reason for 121,401 job cuts in 2026 through October. Entry-level postings are down 7.5% in a year while senior postings are up 14.7%. The government's own forecast for office jobs puts AI in writing. And freelance translation work in Western languages fell 30% in the first year after ChatGPT.

Then the jobs nobody believes are at risk: welders and maintenance workers. I show exactly where the robots stand, what is actually deployed and what is still a pilot or a prototype, and when I think a robot in your house does the repair. Then the part that worries me most. In one poll, 70% of Americans say AI will cut jobs, but only 30% of the people with a job are worried about their own. What does the job market look like for you?
